summary: Practise construction claim notices, EOT analysis, cost substantiation, and negotiation. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: Construction claims management training helps project professionals assess time and payment claims. Contract managers, quantity surveyors, engineers and project controls staff practise tracking notice deadlines, organizing contemporaneous records, assessing delay against schedules, substantiating costs, and preparing claim narratives and resolution options using FIDIC scenarios and the SCL Protocol.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, administer, or resolve time and payment claims on construction and infrastructure projects.
modules: Construction Claim Quantum and Cost Evidence
prerequisites: Prior experience in construction or infrastructure project delivery, contract administration, commercial management, project controls, or claims review is recommended. You should be able to read basic project correspondence and schedules. No coding is required; bring a laptop with spreadsheet software for the applied exercises. No specific software licence or pre-course dataset is assumed to be provided.
